root.body: 📲 **All product views: iPad**. These are live captures, taken 2026-09-26. Each reply shows portrait (768×1024) and then landscape (1180×820). Portrait falls on the ≤768px breakpoint, so it gets the mobile tree. Landscape gets the desktop tree. There are 21 views per orientation.
